title: Tracking heat down to transistor flips · ET-SoC-1
description: Seven weeks on one zoomable, swipeable time axis, from Horace He's result that a matmul runs faster on predictable data down to femtojoules per flipped bit on an ET-SoC-1: 155 questions with their own words, 61 agent sessions in ten lanes on five machines, 871 measurements holding a card, and 39 write-ups, with what is measured so far and what is still missing.
